invariants.D01-INV-BLOCK-LEN: zero, maximum, misaligned, oversize and short-buffer block lengths are typed errors
invariants.D01-INV-BYTES-PER-FRAME: bytes per frame is explicit: channels x container bytes, for every format and channel count
invariants.D01-INV-ENDIAN: bit-exact big- and little-endian byte vectors for every sample format
invariants.D01-INV-NO-ALLOC: the render path (convert, ring, sink) performs no allocator calls
invariants.D01-INV-NONFINITE: NaN and +/-inf become silence, never full scale, and are counted
invariants.D01-INV-RING-WRAP: bounded SPSC ring: FIFO across wrap, exact-capacity, full, underrun, never-fits
invariants.D01-INV-ROUNDTRIP-E2E: known PCM round-trips conversion, ring and sink and equals the independent reference
invariants.D01-INV-SATURATE: saturation at both rails is counted and never wraps
invariants.D01-INV-SCALE-COMPAT: legacy i16 helpers and the stereo wire path use the D01 scale and round-trip all 65536 values
invariants.D01-INV-STRIDE-LAYOUT: interleaved strides with padding, planar planes, and untouched padding/guard bytes
invariants.D01-INV-WIDTH-SIGN: bit-exact width and sign conversion between s16, s24-in-32, s32 and f32 (shift / round-half-up / ties-even)
